en: Colorized photographic postcard showing a large corner building complex with red roofs and light-colored walls, identified as a university children's clinic. People are visible on the unpaved street in front of the building. The caption at the bottom front is in Hungarian. The reverse side is a standard divided back postcard layout with printer information in Hungarian.
